description: Merge several course calendars into one and list timed events that overlap. Inputs: calendars (each with an optional name and an ics string), optional calendar_name and optional output_path. Events with the same UID are kept once. Weekly and daily recurring events are expanded when conflicts are checked. Example prompt: "Merge my three course calendars and tell me which classes conflict."

calendar_name.description: Name for the merged calendar. Defaults to "Merged course calendar".

calendars.description: The calendars to merge, each with the calendar text and an optional name.

name.description: A name for the calendar, such as BIO 101.

output_path.description: Optional file path. When it is passed, the calendar is written there as a .ics file.

name: merge_calendars

calendar_count.description: How many calendars were passed in.

conflicts.description: Every pair of timed events that overlaps, in date order.

date.description: Date of the overlap as YYYY-MM-DD.

end_time.description: End of the overlap as HH:MM.

events.description: The two events that overlap, each with its calendar name.

overlap_minutes.description: How many minutes the two events overlap.

start_time.description: Start of the overlap as HH:MM.

errors.description: Problems found by the checks. Empty when the calendar is valid.

event_count.description: How many events the merged calendar holds, after repeated UIDs are dropped.

ics.description: The merged calendar as text, with CRLF line breaks.

output_path.description: The file path the calendar was written to, or null when no path was passed.

valid.description: True when the merged calendar passed the built in checks.

title: Merge course calendars
